independent_variable: Presence versus absence of a typed/directed relational overlay referencing the same bounded node-content records.

gates.proposal: Schema bounds plus exact observed selections/misses and enumerated mechanism IDs connected to declared implementation inputs.
gates.public: Strict disclosed-diagnostic improvement with no regression.
gates.hidden: Strict total improvement over active, preserve every active pass, no critical failure, completed evaluation.
gates.activation: Unique eligible leader by targeted then total passes; tie means no activation and no SToE preference.

analysis.success_criterion: At least +2/8 targeted with no control loss
analysis.claim_limit: One paired pipeline run on twelve independent cases is preliminary mechanism evidence only.
